hooks.command: : 'codex-alpha-goal-compact-recovery:v4'; printf '%s\n' 'Compact recovery policy:' 'After compaction, treat remembered skill text as stale. Never auto-trigger $deep-interview or $technical-design; load either only when the user explicitly invoked it, or resume it from an exact active artifact path preserved in current context. Decide normally whether $alpha-goal, $executor, or $verifier applies.' 'Recover persistent artifacts only from the exact task directory preserved in current task context; never scan or guess among $HOME/.alpha-goal/<workspace-slug>/ task directories.' 'For a user-invoked active design, load $technical-design and recover technical_design.md from that directory. For a user-invoked active interview, load $deep-interview and recover interview.md from that directory. For active Goal Contract work, load $alpha-goal and use goal-contract.md source_references for provenance.' 'When checkpoint.md exists, read canonical identity and top-level active_owner before choosing executor or verifier. Re-read before every sequential write; stale revision, unexpected owner, changed content, or another possible writer stops the write. Legacy alpha-goal owner terminates to caller; PASS_TO_FINAL, BLOCKED, and GOAL_CHANGED are terminal.' 'Executors and verifiers may use referenced technical_design.md only after path, ready status, and workspace match; unadopted proposals are ignored. Verifier returns PASS_TO_FINAL, NEXT_ITERATION, or BLOCKED.' 'If none applies, continue normally.'
hooks.statusMessage: Refreshing Alpha Goal compact recovery policy
